how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-wetlands-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:275:obj:0: Kill 8 Fen Creepers, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:275:details:0: I do not know why, but a festering grows within the ⟦E1⟧. Fen Creepers have risen. They are diseased, fevered blisters on the land, and for the fever to break they must be dispatched and allowed to settle back into the marshes.
rows.quest:275:details:1: BThe Fen Creepers shamble amidst the waterways of the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:275:completion:0: This land is soothed by your efforts, and for this I will grant you a boon.
rows.quest:276:obj:0: Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:276:details:0: The Mosshide Gnolls have lived in the ⟦E1⟧ peacefully for many years, but now grow in numbers. Their feet stamp flat the fen's bushes and flowers, and their foul axes cut too much wood to fuel their fires.
rows.quest:276:details:1: BThey are no longer in balance with the land. For the ⟦E1⟧ to survive, the Gnolls must be reduced.
rows.quest:276:details:2: BKill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels. Hunt them to the south, near the Dwarven gate of Algaz. After you do this, return to me.
rows.quest:276:completion:0: By reducing the Gnolls' number, you have tended to the health of the ⟦E1⟧. Although my faith in your people has been taxed in the past, ⟦1⟧, it may yet be restored.
rows.quest:277:obj:0: Bring Rethiel the Greenwarden 9 Crude Flints.
rows.quest:277:details:0: The Mosshides are cutting the trees of the ⟦E1⟧, using the trees' flesh to warm themselves with fire. I will suffer this pain no longer!
rows.quest:277:details:1: BRid the Mosshides of their crude flints, the tools they use to make fire. The flints are borne by all Mosshides except the smaller Mosshide gnolls and Mosshide mongrels.
rows.quest:277:completion:0: ... thank you. I will smash these flints and cast them into the sea, so that they may never again be used to burn living wood.
rows.quest:279:obj:1: BSlay Gobbler and take his head.
rows.quest:279:obj:2: BBring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:279:details:0: Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline. They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.
rows.quest:279:details:1: BOne of these murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other bluegill murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby murloc hovels. Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.
rows.quest:279:details:2: BGobbler prowls the river inlet north of here. Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.
rows.quest:279:completion:1: BAccept this as payment for fulfillment of your contract with the Merchant Marines.
rows.quest:281:obj:0: Search the crates and barrels at the coastal Murloc camps.
rows.quest:281:details:0: Not long ago a merchant vessel, the ⟦E3⟧ Princess, was raided by Murlocs. Although the ship escaped intact, much of its cargo was dragged overboard by the creatures, including a very valuable statuette of Terenas Menethil. We want that statuette recovered.
rows.quest:281:details:1: BSearch the coastal Murloc hovels for crates, barrels and other evidence of lost cargo. Find the Menethil Statuette and return it to me.
rows.quest:281:completion:0: This crate is covered with clawed scratches, and the marks of water damage. Prying it open reveals soggy and rotted straw, as if something of value was stored in the crate. You search through the straw...
rows.quest:281:completion:1: B...and find a an armload of red-colored bottles.
rows.quest:284:details:0: You thoroughly search this cluster of Murloc hovels, and find no trace of the Menethil Statuette.
rows.quest:284:details:1: BPerhaps one of the two nearby hovels to the north and northeast will have more clues.
rows.quest:284:completion:0: This barrel is largely untouched. Prying it open...
rows.quest:284:completion:1: B...you are assaulted by the pungent odor of cheese. It's a little wet, but still tasty!
rows.quest:285:obj:0: Continue searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.
rows.quest:285:details:0: This grouping of Murloc hovels, after a thorough inspection, reveals nothing.
rows.quest:285:details:1: B...but you're certain that the next clue you find will be fruitful.
rows.quest:285:details:2: BOne of the hovels to the north must have the Menethil Statuette!
rows.quest:285:completion:0: This barrel is halfway buried amidst the mud and grass ...
rows.quest:286:obj:0: Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.
rows.quest:286:details:0: After pulling the barrel free from the muck and opening it, a silvery figurine is found packed in fine straw. It depicts a young, long-haired Paladin with hammer upraised.
rows.quest:286:details:1: BThis must be the Menethil Statuette! You must now return it to Karl Boran in Menethil ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:286:completion:0: The captain of the ⟦E3⟧ Princess will be relieved to hear this precious cargo has been recovered. You have well earned this payment for services rendered.
rows.quest:286:completion:1: BIt is good to see dependable folk like you, especially in trying times such as these.
rows.quest:288:obj:0: Buy First Mate Fitzsimmons a Flagon of Mead.
rows.quest:288:details:0: I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet. The Doomed Fleet. Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked by Red Dragons. Dragons controlled by Orcs!
rows.quest:288:details:1: BWe didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast. I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...
rows.quest:288:details:2: B...Oh, my head hammers and pounds! I'll need a fresh drink if I'm to get a handle on this hangover and continue my tale.
rows.quest:288:completion:0: Ah! That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue. Thanks, mate!
rows.quest:289:obj:0: Kill 13 Cursed Sailors, 5 Cursed Marines and First Mate Snellig. Bring Snellig's Snuffbox to First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:289:details:1: BI am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.
rows.quest:289:details:2: BBut if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.
rows.quest:289:completion:0: My thanks to you, ⟦3⟧. And the gratitude of my cursed brethren goes to you as well.
rows.quest:290:obj:0: Get the Intrepid Strongbox Key from Captain Halyndor.
rows.quest:290:obj:1: BUse the key to open the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.
rows.quest:290:details:0: To break the curse and free all of my brethren, the...thing...stowed on my ship must be retrieved and cleansed! I don't know what it was, but I do know that it was stored securely in the ship's strongbox, which Captain Halyndor lorded over.
rows.quest:290:details:1: BMy old captain is still in my dreams. I know he walks my doomed ship, the Intrepid. Get the key from him, and use it to open the Intrepid's strongbox.
rows.quest:290:details:2: BThen, after you have the cursed thing, bring it to the priest Glorin Steelbrow in town.
rows.quest:290:completion:0: The key is rusted but it fits the lock neatly.
rows.quest:292:obj:0: Bring the Cursed Eye of Paleth to Glorin Steelbrow.
rows.quest:292:details:0: Opening the chest reveals a blackened orb, pulsing with an eerie light. It is the treasure of which Fitzsimmons spoke: a Cursed Eye of Paleth.
rows.quest:292:details:1: BTake the Cursed Eye of Paleth to the dwarven priest Glorin Steelbrow, in Menethil ⟦E2⟧. Ask him how to remove the Eye's curse.
rows.quest:292:completion:0: An Eye of Paleth? Amazing! Hmm... there's something wrong with this one. You found it on one of those shipwrecks? Well that explains it! But... I didn't know they had such an Eye on the Third Fleet...
rows.quest:292:completion:1: BIt's no wonder Fitzsimmons was so spooked. A Cursed Eye of Paleth is no cause for mirth.
rows.quest:293:obj:0: Bring Archbishop Benedictus the Cursed Eye of Paleth. Benedictus is in the Cathedral of Light, in the city of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:293:details:0: I can't lift the curse from the Eye of Paleth. The Eyes were crafted by Human Priests, so you'll have to go to ⟦E4⟧ to find someone who can help you. Speak with Archbishop Benedictus. He is head of the Cathedral of Light in ⟦E4⟧. He can help.
rows.quest:293:completion:0: An Eye of Paleth. But this one has seen much sorrow...it must have been witness to a terrible, terrible tragedy.
rows.quest:293:completion:1: BLet me cleanse it, for the Eyes were created to shine bright, and their powers can be quite dangerous if tainted like this one.
rows.quest:294:obj:0: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill 10 Mottled Screechers and 10 Mottled Raptors.
rows.quest:294:details:0: The situation is severe, that much is for sure. When we uncovered these bones it attracted the Raptors. These filthy beasts killed my brethren and trapped me, Merrin and the poor Prospector up here.
rows.quest:294:details:1: BHelp clear the ⟦E1⟧ of these Raptors, ⟦4⟧. Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers are just West of the bluff there. Kill 10 of each, if you can.
rows.quest:294:details:2: BThat will be a good start to the vengeance I have planned for them.
rows.quest:294:completion:0: Killing is a dirty business, but you did your job well, ⟦5⟧. If I weren't obligated to stay with the Prospector and Merrin, I'd be down there shedding blood right along side you.
rows.quest:295:obj:0: Ormer Ironbraid wants you to kill 10 Mottled Scytheclaw raptors and 10 Mottled Razormaw raptors then return to him at the Whelgar Excavation Site.
rows.quest:295:details:0: Now it's time to really make those dreaded Raptors regret their blood-thirst. Just down below there are scores of Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws. Make those rotten creatures pay by slaying 10 of each!
rows.quest:295:completion:0: You did a bang-up job of clearing out those Raptors, ⟦6⟧!
rows.quest:296:obj:0: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.
rows.quest:296:details:0: While you were down there I happened to notice that one of those beasts stood out from the rest. He was bigger and more menacing. I bet he's the one who led the others here to cause the disruption to the dig site.
rows.quest:296:details:1: BI ask of you now one final task, ⟦7⟧. See to it that Sarltooth is brought to justice. And considering the gravity of his crimes, justice in this case means death! Bring me one of his talons as proof of his death.
rows.quest:296:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦8⟧. Your efforts here will not be forgotten. Many innocent Dwarves died at this site, simply doing their jobs. The vengeance you delivered to those evil creatures should make them think twice before attacking King Magni's subjects ever again.
rows.quest:299:obj:0: Prospector Whelgar wants you to scour the excavation site in search of the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru.
rows.quest:299:details:0: Just before the invasion I uncovered a large tablet called the Goaz Stone. The translated text breaks off in 4 places. The text speaks of a "divine plan" and a "doomed prophecy."
rows.quest:299:details:1: BI fear we are running out of time. I am too old to go down and brave those beasts. But you are strong.
rows.quest:299:details:2: BScour the excavation site and uncover the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru. Search for them in ancient artifacts or where the soil is loose. Bring them to me so I can begin unlocking the mystery!
rows.quest:299:completion:0: Ah the Goaz Stone is complete! Fine work, ⟦9⟧. Fine work indeed. Now I can continue with the delicate translation of this Titan script. I can make out new words already! Hmm. . .it says here, "Old Gods. . .Chained Beneath the Land." This is the beginning of something epic.
rows.quest:303:obj:0: Motley Garmason at Dun Modr wants you to kill 10 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Dark Iron Tunnelers, 5 Dark Iron Saboteurs and 5 Dark Iron Demolitionists.
rows.quest:303:details:0: War rages both home and abroad. While mighty Dwarven soldiers give their lives in far off territories in the name of the ⟦E5⟧, our own lands fall prey to the evil deeds of the Dark Iron Dwarves. They laid waste to the Thandol Span. Dun Modr fell soon after.
rows.quest:303:details:1: BWe need you to gather force and push the front back. If you can kill 10 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Tunnelers, 5 Saboteurs and 5 Demolitionists, the reserve might arrive in time to finish the drive.
rows.quest:303:completion:0: You upheld your orders well, ⟦10⟧. You have proven yourself to be a valiant soldier and loyal servant to King Magni and for that I salute you! With the pressure you applied to the Dark Iron encampment, we now stand a chance of driving them off our lands for good. . .if only the damned reserve would show. . . .
rows.quest:304:obj:0: Kill Balgaras the Foul and bring his ear to Longbraid the Grim outside of Dun Modr.
rows.quest:304:details:0: Many of my soldiers died in the battle of Dun Modr. My own brother perished when the West Bridge over the Thandol Span was destroyed. Aye, the Dark Iron dwarves are a devilish breed. From what Roggo was able to gather, the leader of the thugs in the ⟦E1⟧ is a warlock named Balgaras the Foul. He is quite a coward, sending his soldiers to do his bidding but hides in his camp on Direforge Hill, to the southeast.
rows.quest:304:details:1: BIf you can find the spineless scum, slay him and bring me his ear. I will reward you, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:304:completion:0: Balgaras the Foul is finally dead. While his death will not bring back the many innocent dwarves who died needlessly by his hand, it will help to restore peace of mind to those who survived. With Balgaras dead, the remaining Dark Iron scum should be easy enough to manage. Now, we must wipe them out before a new leader is sent to these parts.
rows.quest:305:obj:0: Tarrel Rockweaver wants you to travel to the Excavation Site and contact Merrin Rockweaver.
rows.quest:305:details:0: Oh my, you must be the scout Longbraid said he would send! You cannot imagine how worried I have been.
rows.quest:305:details:1: BMy wife, Merrin, has been sending me letters each week for the past month. She is part of the Whelgar Excavation team. But it has been nearly two weeks since her last correspondence. Surely something is wrong!
rows.quest:305:details:2: BLongbraid said that he would send a scout to check up on things if we did not hear from the team soon. I assume that scout is you, ⟦13⟧. Find Merrin at the excavation site to the east!
rows.quest:305:completion:0: Oh, thank the heavens you are here!
rows.quest:306:obj:0: Return to Tarrel Rockweaver with Merrin's note.
rows.quest:306:details:0: It was horrible! We were uncovering some rare artifacts and we began to discover these large bones.
rows.quest:306:details:1: BBefore we knew what was happening, these Mottled Raptors overwhelmed the dig site. Many lives were lost.
rows.quest:306:details:2: BOrmer here -- so brave -- saved the Prospector and me. He defended us as we ran for shelter. Now we are trapped. And our hard work lies in ruin.
rows.quest:306:details:3: BHere, take this note back to my sweet Tarrel. It will explain the situation to him.
rows.quest:306:completion:0: Such horrible news! At least 3 of them survived. But when will the killing end? I long for the day when King Magni's subjects can live without fear.
rows.quest:455:obj:1: BKill 8 Dragonmaw Scouts and 6 Dragonmaw Grunts.
rows.quest:455:obj:2: BReport to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:455:details:0: Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have a haven in the ⟦E1⟧. And now they have expanded into Dun Algaz! We can't let them keep their foothold here or ⟦E6⟧ will be cut off from Menethil ⟦E2⟧, our port and stronghold in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:455:details:1: BBreak through Dun Algaz to the ⟦E1⟧ beyond, and kill some orcs for good measure! Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:455:details:2: BMenethil is through Dun Algaz, then north along the road, then west at the fork.
rows.quest:455:details:3: BWe're counting on you, ⟦14⟧. Do not fail.
rows.quest:455:completion:0: Your report is full of bad news!
rows.quest:455:completion:1: BI see the Dragonmaws are making a strong move into Algaz. Normally the Dragonmaws just hide up in the hills. What made them surge into Algaz is still a mystery...
rows.quest:455:completion:2: BThank you, ⟦15⟧. And we'll probably want your help dealing with these orcs.
rows.quest:463:details:0: You've heard of the Greenwarden? You're not looking for him, are you? Well I say you're crazy if you are, but who am I to keep a fool from ⟦16⟧ death?
rows.quest:463:details:1: BIf you are seeking that beast, then I hear he is in the marsh, east of the road where it forks to Dun Modr. He's lurking there among the crocs...and worse!
rows.quest:463:details:2: BAnd leave your money here. You won't need it where you're going...and you don't want to chip ol' Greenie's tooth on your gold when he bites you in half, do you?
rows.quest:463:completion:0: The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to only a few. But you may call me Rethiel.
rows.quest:463:completion:1: BAnd you must harken...for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.
rows.quest:464:obj:0: Bring 8 Dragonmaw War Banners to Captain Stoutfist.
rows.quest:464:details:0: The Dragonmaw orc clan was all but destroyed by the end of the Second War, after they lost control of their red dragon pets. The dragons were not very happy with their old masters, and fiercely hunted the Dragonmaws. What few remained fled from Grim Batol and into the Mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation.
rows.quest:464:details:1: BNow they've gained strength, and have an encampment northeast of Menethil.
rows.quest:464:details:2: BWe want you to attack that encampment. Gather and bring me their war banners as proof.
rows.quest:464:completion:0: Well fought, ⟦17⟧. The Dragonmaws are not the same threat they were when they had dragons, but they're still fierce opponents.
rows.quest:464:completion:1: BThe Dragonmaws are led by Nek'rosh, son of Nekros, who was the former head of the Dragonmaws years ago. Nekros used powerful magic to tame the Red Dragons, but when that magic failed him...the dragons were not happy.
rows.quest:464:completion:2: BNekros was killed, and his son has vowed revenge against the dragons who slew his father.
rows.quest:465:details:0: While you were fighting the Dragonmaws, we discovered more of their plans.
rows.quest:465:details:1: BNek'rosh has built catapults and aims to lay siege to Menethil! And with the fighting in Dun Algaz, we're effectively blocked from reinforcements!
rows.quest:465:details:2: BYou need to take out those catapults. They're in the Dragonmaw encampment.
rows.quest:465:details:3: BHere, take this tinder. Fight your way to the catapults and light them with the tinder.
rows.quest:465:details:4: BAnd after you've done that, find and kill Nek'rosh. We need to cut this Dragonmaw beast down...at its neck.
rows.quest:465:completion:0: You place some of the tinder on the catapult then strike a ⟦E7⟧ onto it.
rows.quest:468:details:0: Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:468:details:1: BIf you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz. Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.
rows.quest:468:completion:0: Hello, ⟦18⟧! You're here for the scouting mission, are you? Very good!
rows.quest:468:completion:1: BI hope your gear is in good condition, because this "scouting" mission has changed into something more messy...
rows.quest:469:obj:0: Deliver the Bundle of Crocolisk Skins to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:469:details:1: BDon't suppose you might be heading in the direction of Menethil, would you? If you're not, I'd suggest you stop there, it's a good place to purchase goods and even have a pint and relax.
rows.quest:469:details:2: BNow, if it just so happens that you're heading in that direction, I don't suppose you'd mind taking this bundle of crocolisk skins to James Halloran, the tanner?
rows.quest:469:details:3: BI'd do it myself, but my wife's been in quite a mood lately, and I'd like to put off facing her as long as possible.
rows.quest:469:completion:0: Hmm, this is from Einar, right? Hasn't delivered his skins to me in person for almost a week now. No doubt it's some differences with the wife!
rows.quest:469:completion:1: BMaybe I'll have my wife go speak with Sida sometime...
rows.quest:470:obj:0: One of the oozes at Ironbeard's Tomb has Sida's bag, retrieve it and bring it back to her in Menethil ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:470:details:0: On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.
rows.quest:470:details:1: BI threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.
rows.quest:470:details:2: BThe bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!
rows.quest:470:details:3: BI don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!
rows.quest:470:completion:0: Oh, thank you, ⟦19⟧! I was afraid that it was lost for good!
rows.quest:470:completion:1: B<She quickly empties the contents of the ooze-covered bag onto the ground, before scooping them up.>
rows.quest:470:completion:2: BHm, I don't have much use for this anymore, but wash it off and I'm sure you could make use of it.
rows.quest:471:obj:0: Collect 6 Giant Crocolisk Skins and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:471:details:0: I sent my apprentice out into the marshes to skin some of our famous giant ⟦E1⟧ crocolisks. When he didn't return, I went out to look for him... Let's just say it wasn't a pretty sight.
rows.quest:471:details:1: BMidwife says he might pull through, but in the meantime I still need my skins!
rows.quest:471:details:2: B...If you'd like to kill a few more of the brutes, I wouldn't be opposed, after what they did. You'll find the crocs north up the coast, beyond the murloc hovels.
rows.quest:471:completion:0: Hmm... Don't suppose you'd be interested in becoming my apprentice, would you?
rows.quest:471:completion:1: BHah! No, I'm just kidding. You're much too old, for one thing. Besides - from the looks of you, it would seem that you have other ambitions in life. Nonetheless, these are some fine skins you've procured, and I'll be able to put them to good use.
rows.quest:472:obj:0: Search for Longbraid near the town of Dun Modr.
rows.quest:472:details:0: Dun Modr has fallen to the Dark Iron Dwarves!
rows.quest:472:details:1: BMy wounds are grave, ⟦20⟧. Most of the regiment was killed! The Dark Iron thugs attacked us before we could regroup from the Thandol Span ambush.
rows.quest:472:details:2: BOur leader, Longbraid, sounded the retreat horn. As we left the town I was hit by a stray axe in the back. All went black.
rows.quest:472:details:3: BI awoke here in Menethil but I fear for my fellow soldiers. ⟦E8⟧ still burns within me. Perhaps Longbraid is still alive! See if you can find him near Dun Modr, ⟦21⟧!
rows.quest:472:completion:0: What brave ⟦22⟧ sends word from Menethil? Ah ⟦23⟧, they call you.
rows.quest:472:completion:1: BYou bring hope to a hopeless situation. 'Tis good news indeed that young Harlo survived. While fleeing he received a grievous wound. We had but little time to send him on his way on the back of the only surviving steed with the regiment.
rows.quest:472:completion:2: BBut now we face a perilous situation. Dun Modr has fallen and we are but a shadow of the great regiment we once were.
rows.quest:473:details:0: ⟦24⟧. The Dragonmaw orc clan is showing its strength in more than just Algaz. Captain Stoutfist has asked to speak with those willing to offer aid against these orcs. He is inside the keep, in the war room.
rows.quest:473:completion:0: ⟦25⟧. Valstag briefed me on your past success with the Dragonmaw Orcs at Dun Algaz. You're a ⟦26⟧ of worth.
rows.quest:473:completion:1: BAnd I have a task for you.
rows.quest:474:obj:1: BBring Nek'rosh's Head to Captain Stoutfist.
rows.quest:474:details:0: Now that the catapults have been burned, find and kill Chieftain Nek'rosh.
rows.quest:474:completion:0: Stoutly done, ⟦27⟧. You have dealt a telling blow to the Dragonmaw orc clan. They may never recover. And the destruction of those catapults has made Menethil ⟦E2⟧ safe.
rows.quest:474:completion:1: BYou are a ⟦28⟧ of merit, and the kingdom of ⟦E9⟧ rewards those who serve it well.
rows.quest:484:obj:0: Obtain 4 Young Crocolisk Skins for James Halloran in Menethil ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:484:details:0: I'm James Halloran, the tanner. My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.
rows.quest:484:details:1: BMet Einar? He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.
rows.quest:484:details:2: BI'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.
rows.quest:484:details:3: BBeing that I'm running low, I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. You can find the young crocs in the marshes right outside of town.
rows.quest:484:completion:0: Nice work you've done here, ⟦29⟧. The quality of these skins is superb. I'll have to get them into the curing process as soon as possible. Oh, but before I get to that, there's some other work I need done that I think you might be able to take care of.
rows.quest:631:obj:0: Rhag Garmason wants you to locate Ol' Rustlocke.
rows.quest:631:details:0: A tremendous explosion roared through the hills. 'Twas horrible, I tell you!
rows.quest:631:details:1: BGood soldiers died defending the Thandol Span. Longbraid says we'll take revenge on the Dark Irons before all is said and done.
rows.quest:631:details:2: BWe're in a world of hurt though and I don't see any reinforcements in sight. Longbraid sent Ol' Rustlocke to scout the eastern bridge to see if we could secure it.
rows.quest:631:details:3: BThat was days ago. We haven't the manpower to search for him with Dun Modr under siege.
rows.quest:631:completion:0: You search the tiny, dwarven corpse. Engraved into the helmet you can clearly read: Ebenezer Rustlocke.
rows.quest:632:obj:0: Report back to Rhag Garmason and show him the parchment you found on Rustlocke's corpse.
rows.quest:632:details:0: It seems as though poor Ol' Rustlocke ran into a Dark Iron ambush. You notice a parchment next to his clenched fist.
rows.quest:632:details:1: BReport the grim news to Rhag Garmason and show him what you found.
rows.quest:632:completion:0: Oh my, the news is grave....
rows.quest:633:details:0: Heavens no! Poor Rustlocke. 'Tis quite a tragedy indeed.
rows.quest:633:details:1: BWe must not let his death pass in vain. This parchment you discovered indicates that Kam Deepfury, the mastermind behind the original attack, arranged for a cache of explosives to be stashed just across the Thandol Span, in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:633:details:2: BIf those explosives make it to the bridge, our major supply line to the north will be severed! The cache must be destroyed, ⟦30⟧! Return to me when your mission is complete.
rows.quest:633:completion:0: The remaining bridge is saved! You have done a great service to King Magni and the people of Khaz Modan.
rows.quest:633:completion:1: BNow if we can only hold out long enough for reinforcements to show...
rows.quest:634:obj:0: Seek out Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:634:details:0: I ask of you one more small favor, ⟦31⟧. We await the reserves of ⟦E9⟧. However, Roggo has knowledge of an ⟦E5⟧ camp to the north in ⟦E10⟧ at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:634:details:1: BTravel there and seek out Captain Nials. Ask the good Captain if the ⟦E5⟧ can spare some soldiers to help us reclaim Dun Modr and the Thandol Span.
rows.quest:634:completion:0: My condolences go out to Longbraid and his brave soldiers. The news of the Thandol Span tragedy and the fall of Dun Modr hangs heavy in my heart.
rows.quest:634:completion:1: BBut Stromgarde has fallen! Hence our presence here at Refuge Pointe. We are faced with retaking our own great city.
rows.quest:634:completion:2: BHonor and duty require that we do not leave the Highlands until Stromgarde raises the mighty banner of the King once again. I will send word to Longbraid that he is on his own...
rows.quest:647:obj:0: Take MacKreel's Moonshine to Brewmeister Bilger in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:647:details:0: Had quite a bit of the ol' Moonshine last night! Longbraid would have my head if he knew that I passed out during my watch.
rows.quest:647:details:1: BThe noggin hurts something fierce. Felt as though a whole brigade of siege engines passed overhead, all that rumbling.
rows.quest:647:details:2: BOh my, look at the time! I promised Brewmeister Bilger in ⟦E11⟧ that I'd repay my debt to him by sending some Moonshine.
rows.quest:647:details:3: BBut there are just 15 minutes left before I'm overdue! Take him this batch, would you please? And hurry!
rows.quest:647:completion:0: Ah, nothing like Foggy MacKreel's Moonshine to warm you up on a brisk day! And here I was thinking the little bugger was going to be overdue on his bills again. Thank you, friend! Many thanks indeed!
rows.quest:1132:obj:0: Speak with Fiora Longears on the docks at ⟦E12⟧ in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:1132:details:0: Oh, to be at sea once again! To feel the kiss of the wind, and to have the waves rock me like my blessed mother, long ago!
rows.quest:1132:details:1: BOh, I wish I had your fortune, good ⟦32⟧, for I see the sea in your future!
rows.quest:1132:details:2: BIt's my job to tell eager souls of the land of ⟦E14⟧, the land of opportunity! If you're willing to try your luck across the sea, then take a ship from here to the lovely port of ⟦E12⟧. Speak there with my partner, the elf, Fiora Longears.
rows.quest:1132:details:3: BShe'll start you on your ⟦E14⟧ adventure!
rows.quest:1132:completion:0: Good day to you! You were sent by Mr. Flint in Menethil ⟦E2⟧? Well Mr. Flint is a strong judge of character. If he sent you, then there's no doubt you belong here in ⟦E14⟧!
rows.quest:1302:obj:0: Speak with Clerk Lendry at Foothold Citadel in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:1302:details:0: My brother James went with Lady Proudmoore across the sea. Last I heard, the fighting had settled down over there, and James was setting up an inn somewhere on the continent. Wherever he is, I'm sure he's doing good business. Damn fine cook he was.
rows.quest:1302:details:1: BI haven't heard from him for a while now--too busy with his inn, I'd wager--but the clerk in ⟦E12⟧ could probably point you to him. Look for him on the top floor of that keep near the middle of the city. What's it called... Foothold Citadel, that's it.
rows.quest:1302:completion:0: James Hyal, James Hyal... Why does that name sound so familiar?
rows.quest:1302:completion:1: BOf course! The Shady Rest Inn incident. If you have any information about what happened there, I would urge you to speak with Captain Vimes about it. He's handling the investigation.
